name: The Mad Hatter's Apprentice
source:
As a decent and normal hatter,  you came to the Mad Hatter's to gain some madness. You are confused as you cannot find the Mad Hatter himself for advice, and have to take care of the shop and customers with bizarre requirements. Together with Alice from Wonderland, you embark on the journey to madness in hatship.

[From [url=https://yuff.itch.io/the-mad-hatters-apprentice]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
作为一个正派、普通的帽子匠，你来到疯帽子店是为了获得一些疯狂。你很困惑，因为你找不到疯帽子本人寻求建议，而不得不照顾商店和有奇怪要求的顾客。你和来自仙境的爱丽丝一起，乘坐飞船踏上了疯狂之旅。

[来自[url=https://yuff.itch.io/the-mad-hatters-apprentice]itch.io[/url]]
